ValidationRule.description: Validates that the required information has been captured before resolving or closing a complaint.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Resolved') ), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Complaint_Outcome__c)), ISBLANK(IDR_Description_of_Outcome__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields, in the "Resolution Information" section, are required in order to resolve or close a complaint: Complaint Outcome, Description of Outcome.
